max_wal_senders.description: number of concurrent connections that can send WAL data to standby servers or streaming clients.

autovacuum_max_workers.description: perform automatic VACUUM and ANALYZE tasks, cleaning up dead tuples (bloat) from updated/deleted rows and updating statistics for query planning, ensuring efficient space reuse and good performance without manual intervention.

max_connections.description: maximum number of concurrent connections to the database server.

wal_buffers.description: size of the shared memory buffer used for WAL data.

shared_buffers.description: size of the shared memory buffer used for caching data pages.

autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor.description: proportion of table size that, when exceeded by the number of updated or deleted tuples, triggers an automatic ANALYZE operation to update statistics for query planning.

autovacuum_analyze_threshold.description: minimum number of updated or deleted tuples that triggers an automatic ANALYZE operation to update statistics for query planning.

autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay.description: delay between autovacuum operations to limit I/O impact.

autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit.description: maximum number of tuples that can be processed in a single autovacuum operation.

autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor.description: proportion of table size that, when exceeded by the number of updated or deleted tuples, triggers an automatic VACUUM operation to clean up dead tuples.

autovacuum_vacuum_threshold.description: minimum number of updated or deleted tuples that triggers an automatic VACUUM operation to clean up dead tuples.

backend_flush_after.description: number of data pages that a backend process will flush to disk after a write operation.

bgwriter_delay.description: time interval between background writer operations.

bgwriter_flush_after.description: number of data pages that the background writer will flush to disk after a write operation.

bgwriter_lru_maxpages.description: maximum number of LRU pages that the background writer will write per round.

bgwriter_lru_multiplier.description: multiplier for the number of LRU pages that the background writer will write per round.

checkpoint_completion_target.description: target duration for checkpoint completion as a fraction of the checkpoint interval.

checkpoint_flush_after.description: number of data pages that will be flushed to disk after a checkpoint.

checkpoint_timeout.description: maximum time between automatic WAL checkpoints.

commit_delay.description: delay between transaction commit and flushing WAL to disk.

commit_siblings.description: number of concurrent open transactions required to trigger commit_delay.

cursor_tuple_fraction.description: fraction of the result set that will be retrieved by a cursor.

deadlock_timeout.description: time to wait on a lock before checking for deadlock.

default_statistics_target.description: default level of detail for table statistics used by the query planner.

effective_cache_size.description: estimated size of the disk cache available to PostgreSQL for caching data pages.

effective_io_concurrency.description: number of concurrent I/O operations that can be performed.

from_collapse_limit.description: maximum number of FROM items that the query planner will consider collapsing into a single join.

geqo_effort.description: effort level for the genetic query optimizer (GEQO), influencing the thoroughness of the optimization process.

geqo_generations.description: number of generations for the genetic query optimizer (GEQO) to evolve query plans.

geqo_pool_size.description: size of the population pool for the genetic query optimizer (GEQO).

geqo_seed.description: seed value for the random number generator used by the genetic query optimizer (GEQO).

geqo_threshold.description: number of FROM items above which the genetic query optimizer (GEQO) is used.

join_collapse_limit.description: maximum number of JOIN items that the query planner will consider collapsing into a single join.

maintenance_work_mem.description: amount of memory to be used by maintenance operations, such as VACUUM, CREATE INDEX, and ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY.

temp_buffers.description: amount of memory allocated for temporary tables used by each database session.

temp_file_limit.description: maximum size of temporary files that a session can create.

vacuum_cost_delay.description: delay between vacuum operations to limit I/O impact.

vacuum_cost_limit.description: maximum number of tuples that can be processed in a single vacuum operation.

vacuum_cost_page_dirty.description: cost assigned to writing a dirty page to disk during vacuum.

vacuum_cost_page_hit.description: cost assigned to accessing a page that is already in memory during vacuum.

vacuum_cost_page_miss.description: cost assigned to reading a page from disk during vacuum.

wal_writer_delay.description: time interval between WAL writer operations.

work_mem.description: amount of memory to be used by internal sort operations and hash tables before writing to temporary disk files.
